System Analyzer, step 1 (L1 + L2): mockup

Drawn on the real v2026.10.14.80 page: the D-Scan results are the tool’s own (ESI served from the SDE). Everything in the System Analyzer itself is mocked, with made-up alliance, corporation and pilot names. Dashed amber outlines mark what’s new. Already decided (plan D1–D6): this tab replaces the D-Scan tab, in its place; friendlies come from your pilot’s corp and alliance plus any you add; neutral and hostile are shown separately; your hostile list wins over the zKillboard evidence; above 15 hostile + neutral pilots, local is shown by group.

1. The tab after a paste (desktop)

How it’s worked out: step 1 uses ESI only, plus one zKillboard request (Q2). The names go to ESI /universe/ids/ (up to 500 per request), the pilots to /characters/affiliation/ (up to 1000), then one /universe/names/ for the corp and alliance names. That’s 3 ESI requests for this local. A name ESI doesn’t know (a typo, a renamed pilot) is listed as not found, and the rest of the paste still works. Pilots in NPC corporations (starter corps) are their own neutral group. With only a D-Scan pasted, the tab does exactly what the D-Scan tab does today.

Colours: hostile = the page’s existing red, friendly = a new blue (#4f8fe0). That pair passed the colour checker on the page’s dark surface. Neutral is grey on purpose. Each side also has its own shape (− square, ○ circle, + square) and its name, so colour is never the only cue.

2. Where “Your Side” is set

The panel holds your pilot name (its corp and alliance are looked up and shown under it), other friendly alliances or corporations, the hostile list, and the “pilot rows up to” number (D3: default 15, at most 30). All of it is saved in this browser only.

Questions for you

Q1. Your Side: A (a chip beside My Ship, on every tab; my pick) or B (a card inside the System Analyzer)?
Q2. The zKillboard evidence (“Killed 3 of yours in 7 days”): in this first step, or later with L3? It costs 1 zKillboard request per analysis (your alliance’s recent losses, cached 1 hour), plus those killmails from ESI. I’d cap that at the 50 most recent losses. Without it, only your hostile list makes anyone hostile; everyone else shows as neutral.
Q3. Pilots inside a group: up to 6 names per corporation, then “+N more”. Each name opens the Pilot Analyzer. Is that the right amount?
Q4. New names for the one list of names (CARD_NAMES): “System Analyzer”, “Your Side”, “Hostile”, “Neutral”, “Friendly”, “On Scan”. OK as they are?
